# Conditional table-style fixture

`conditional.pptx` is project-authored, generated by `test/table-styles.mjs` from a 5×5 table. The test replaces native cell XML with unformatted row/column labels and embeds a custom DrawingML table style through a nonstandard relationship target. All style toggles are enabled; each region has a distinct gray text color. This isolates style precedence and does not claim native-viewer pixel parity.

Regenerate after building the package:

```sh
OPF_TABLE_STYLE_FIXTURE=test/fixtures/table-styles/conditional.pptx node test/table-styles.mjs
```

The browser harness uses these native bytes; it does not read OPF source metadata. The Node suite separately generates inline, flag, inheritance, unsupported-format and direct-override variations. The archive's content-type declaration follows the relocated table-style part.

References: [DrawingML table-part precedence](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/office_standards/ms-oi29500/90de4085-5fbf-47a7-bc37-d59509481d0a), [table cell text properties](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/documentformat.openxml.drawing.tablecelltextstyle?view=openxml-3.0.1), [table-style insertion default](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/documentformat.openxml.drawing.tablestylelist?view=openxml-3.0.1).
